Facts: Defendant Zhang cut liquid gas cylinder pipe, opened valve to release gas, threatened employer to resign, attempted to ignite gas with lighter. This is an act of arson? He prepared to cause explosion/fire. Under Chinese criminal law, "放火" (arson) is when intentionally setting fire to property, causing fire damage. Here he cut gas cylinder and attempted to ignite, which could cause explosion/fire. The intent is to cause fire/damage to property? He wanted to force resignation, not necessarily to cause damage, but his act is dangerous. Could be "危害公共安全罪" (endangering public safety) e.g., "放火罪" or "非法制造、买卖、运输、储存、使用危险物质罪"? Chinese law: Article 115 (dangerous means) includes using dangerous means to cause explosion, fire, etc. Actually Article 115: "以危险方法危害公共安全罪" includes using explosives, flammable gas, etc. The facts: He cut gas cylinder, opened valve, attempted to ignite. That is using dangerous means to threaten. Likely charge: "放火罪" (arson) because he attempted to set fire using gas. However, the rule says: If the defendant intentionally ignites a building, room, or other structure causing fire damage, the appropriate charge is "放火". Here he didn't actually ignite, only attempted, but still could be attempted arson. So charge: "放火罪". Also maybe "非法持有、使用易燃易爆物质罪"? But Chinese law: Article 119: "非法制造、买卖、运输、储存、提供危险物质罪".
